cells.name: Beast Command
cells.concept: A jade command baton held above a spirit wolf and an iron crane, narrow gold streams unify their forward attack. Clear centered command object, companions secondary.

cells.name: Ancestral Offering
cells.concept: Three small animal-shaped spirit flames spiral into one powerful ancestral horned beast emerging from an ancient bronze altar. The large forming beast dominates.

cells.name: Overwhelm by Numbers
cells.concept: A tight coordinated semicircle of spectral white beasts charging one dark stone adversary, a golden banner above them; strongest focal shape is the unified assault.

cells.name: Battle Roar
cells.concept: A fierce antique bronze martial war-mask roaring, radiating concentric golden shockwaves and dust, a powerful symbol of rising inner strength.

cells.name: Crushing Blow
cells.concept: One heavy bronze gauntlet smashes and fractures a black iron breastplate; bright fault lines reveal the vulnerable opening. Dynamic diagonal impact.

cells.name: Fundamentals
cells.concept: A simple worn steel practice sword and plain round stone shield rest beside a scarred wooden training post, their humble edges awakening with disciplined gold light.

cells.name: Heavy Foundations
cells.concept: A monumental tiered stone foundation supports a colossal plain sword and heavy shield, immense weight bending golden energy downward into the earth.

cells.name: Measured Practice
cells.concept: An ivory-sleeved martial fist strikes the central ring of a worn lacquer training dummy, two clean spectral motion echoes show deliberate repeated practice.

cells.name: Three-Mountain Fist
cells.concept: Three staggered golden fist-shaped force waves advance in succession across three dark mountain peaks, distinct rhythmic triple impact silhouette.

cells.name: Unshaken Resolve
cells.concept: An adult armored cultivator stands unmoving beneath a protective golden arch, two forgotten blades rise from dust beside them, bronze and ivory light against storm.

cells.name: Burn Impurities
cells.concept: Torn dull grey technique paper burns in focused jade flame, its purified warm ash assembles into a protective semicircular armor plate above the fire; no writing on paper.

cells.name: Crucible Shell
cells.concept: A small ancient jade crucible encased by an expanding shell of interlocking golden ash armor scales, a strong luminous protective egg silhouette.

cells.name: Re-Refinement
cells.concept: One suspended sword inside a narrow alchemical flame, lower half still dull stone-grey and upper half newly brilliant jade and gold; a transient halo shows its temporary refinement.

cells.name: Reclaim the Edge
cells.concept: An ivory-sleeved hand lifts a weathered single sword from a bed of cool black ash, fresh golden light runs along its recovered edge.

cells.name: Ash Insight
cells.concept: A plume of fine warm ash forms one luminous celestial eye; two blank ivory scroll ribbons unfold beside it, enlightenment rising from spent embers.

cells.name: White-Hot Edge
cells.concept: A dazzling white-hot sword burns along a steep diagonal, its tip and edge dissolve into golden sparks after one decisive slash, restrained bronze strength aura behind it.

cells.name: Five Weapons Return
cells.concept: Exactly five distinct ancient weapons—a sword, spear, axe, dagger, and halberd—rise in an elegant fan from cold charcoal ash, gold threads recall their edges. Centered readable fan.

cells.name: Hidden Thunder Array
cells.concept: A quiet circular arrangement of black stones conceals a brilliant gold lightning bolt beneath a translucent jade veil, hidden stored thunder gathering before release.

cells.name: Mountain Seal
cells.concept: A thick floating rectangular jade seal sculpted with an abstract mountain relief presses a luminous protective dome around a single rugged rock peak; no written characters.

cells.name: Silent Array
cells.concept: One almost invisible dark glass blade held still inside a precise suspended geometric golden trap, silent poised danger above weathered black stone.

cells.name: Phantom Lattice
cells.concept: A tall folded translucent jade lattice maze wraps around three dim smoke silhouettes, protective geometry turning into a confusing narrowing prison.

cells.name: Seven-Star Array
cells.concept: Seven slender silver flying swords arranged as a seven-star celestial constellation, connected by fine gold threads, deep jade starlit background.

cells.name: Patient Circle
cells.concept: A humble empty meditation cushion sheltered within three accumulating rings of suspended pebbles and pale golden motes, calm patient preparation becoming defense.

cells.name: Heaven-Earth Array
cells.concept: An immense central golden geometric formation plane joins a celestial star vortex above to dark stone mountain roots below, majestic heaven-and-earth convergence.

cells.name: Read the Current
cells.concept: An open ivory-sleeved hand hovers above a dark jade river; three luminous currents rise as three blank ivory leaves, reading what the water will bring.

cells.name: Exchange a Thought
cells.concept: Two elegant scroll ribbons circle one another: an old grey blank sheet dissolves into wind while a fresh ivory blank sheet emerges in warm gold light, clear exchange.

cells.name: Retrieve the Page
cells.concept: Two aged blank manuscript leaves lift from wet black stones toward a warm golden hand-shaped current, knowledge recovered from the discarded past.

cells.name: Inner Sight
cells.concept: A centered celestial eye-shaped portal with a dark pupil reveals three floating amber mirror shards containing stars, focused inward seeing rather than an actual face.

cells.name: Seek the Blade
cells.concept: An elegant jade compass needle points toward one luminous sword partly hidden among dark stones, a clear search and discovery composition without any lettering or diagram labels.

cells.name: Intentional Forgetting
cells.concept: A small blank black scroll dissolves deliberately into pale petals, releasing one bright clean ivory page from its center; peaceful chosen forgetting.

cells.name: Master Strategist
cells.concept: A refined ivory-sleeved strategist's hand positions a jade stone on a compact black Go board, board lines continue into constellations, precise knowledge of future moves.

cells.name: Endless Vitality
cells.concept: An ancient white-jade tree grows fresh green leaves from weathered roots, a perpetual warm golden life halo circulates through roots and crown; divine regenerative power.
